segments.name: QCT IoT & Compute (Snapdragon X Elite / Edge)

tooltips.QCT: Qualcomm CDMA Technologies: semiconductor chip division comprising Handsets, Automotive, IoT, and AI compute.
tooltips.QTL: Qualcomm Technology Licensing: patent licensing division collecting wireless royalty revenues on 3G, 4G, 5G, and Wi-Fi devices.
tooltips.Snapdragon 8 Elite: Qualcomm's 3nm flagship mobile application processor and modem platform featuring custom Oryon CPU cores.
tooltips.Digital Chassis: Qualcomm's comprehensive automotive tech stack covering infotainment, digital cockpit, and ADAS automated driving.
tooltips.Snapdragon X Elite: ARM-based PC processor series delivering 45 TOPS NPU performance for Copilot+ AI personal computers.
tooltips.Input Cost Inflation: Industry-wide price increases across leading-edge wafer fabrication, advanced packaging, memory, and substrate materials.
tooltips.True FCF: Forensic Free Cash Flow: Operating Cash Flow minus CapEx, Share-Based Compensation, and Capital Leases.
tooltips.Oryon CPU: Qualcomm's proprietary custom CPU microarchitecture engineered by Nuvia acquisition, deployed in PC and flagship mobile.
tooltips.QTL License Renewal: Multi-year patent licensing agreements extended with tier-1 OEMs including Apple, Huawei, and Transsion.
tooltips.Data Center AI Ramp: Multi-generational AI cloud acceleration partnership with Amazon targeting $5B in fiscal 2027 revenue.
tooltips.Handset Replacement Cycle: Global smartphone refresh cycles in China and North America influencing volume demand for RF and baseband silicon.
tooltips.EBT Margin: Earnings Before Taxes expressed as a percentage of total segment revenue reflecting underlying operational profitability.
tooltips.Advanced Packaging: 2.5D/3D wafer-level multi-die packaging essential for high-performance AI inference and server chips.
tooltips.SBC Dilution: Stock-based compensation awarded to engineering talent, requiring deduction from cash flow to gauge real economic yield.
tooltips.RF Front-End (RFFE): Radio frequency components including power amplifiers, filters, and antenna tuners paired with Snapdragon modems.
tooltips.China OEM Mix: Qualcomm's exposure to Chinese smartphone manufacturers including Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo, and Honor.
tooltips.ATM Straddle: At-the-Money options straddle pricing 1-week expected volatility post-earnings print.
tooltips.Implied Move Band: The statistically priced expected percentage price excursion derived from options market open interest.
tooltips.Copilot+ PC: Microsoft standard for AI PCs requiring dedicated NPUs delivering over 40 TOPS of compute.
tooltips.Wafer Foundry Allocation: Contract manufacturing agreements with TSMC and Samsung Foundry for 3nm and 4nm node production.
